title: Renewal pending expiry
preconditions: a current permit and required views were independently validated for one live context
one fresh renewal attempt is pending and no successor is installed before permit expiry
steps: begin a fresh renewal while the current permit remains independently valid
delay successor installation until the current permit reaches its exact exclusive expiry
present the late successor after terminal invalidation; attempt to use client or result timestamps to restore freshness
invariants: M1-015 R01: Successful same-context renewal uses a new registered challenge, new current claims, same key/epoch, increasing sequence and every verifier/permit/activation gate
M1-015 R02: Reusing a nonce/evidence/old renewal cannot authorize; later rejection never releases its consumed nonce
M1-015 R03: Starting/retrying renewal never changes the old permit's expiry or revocation-view deadline
M1-015 R04: With intact continuity and still-valid trusted views, a transient attempt failure grants nothing but may leave independently valid existing authorization usable
M1-015 R05: Exact permit/view expiry stops authorization; a reply arriving after terminal invalidation cannot revive the session
M1-015 R12: Expired challenge, profile-duration violation or late evidence cannot become fresh through permit/result/client timestamps
residual_risk: Trusted time and timely reevaluation remain deployment prerequisites.
Specified attack requirement only; runtime implementation and proof remain deferred.
